authoringRequirements: Only after the trigger, invent new entities, values and dates; do not reuse or paraphrase known fixtures.
Questions must explicitly request every explanation required by the strict key; no AM-style key/question mismatch.
Question length/format obligations and corresponding grading rules must agree before any model output is seen.
The author privately verifies facts, arithmetic, units, scope and source authority against original bytes; no model execution while creating the set.
Seal manifest, all source files, key and protocol hashes before first native attempt; preserve original bytes. No retrospective edits from outputs.

Use exactly 20 shared documents, 5000–7000 UTF8 bytes of source text, target 200–400 UTF8 bytes per document with hard maximum 700; include at least 3 genuine irrelevant distractors in addition to cross-query source distractors. Do not pad facts or shorten requested answers merely to fit a score target.

Each case needs 1–3 supporting passages. Questions target 100–230 Unicode codepoints, hard maximum 300 codepoints / 450 UTF8 bytes; explanations required by the key must be explicit in the question. Do not impose artificially shorter answer formats on complex cases.

Before sealing, perform read-only planner admission for every question with all 20 documents in the complete shared corpus: unchanged 8192 context and 2176 output tokens, all supplied inputs retained. No oracle filtering, runtime shrinking, model trial, or regeneration based on outputs. Admission may inspect budgets/schema metadata only.

The5000-byte minimum describes the complete20-document shared corpus, including genuine and cross-query distractors. It is not permission to supply a shorter gold-source subset, remove competing evidence, or shrink runtime context by oracle selection.

blinding.productionContributors: Root and every production contributor remain blind to new facts, sources, key and output contents until the entire declared collection has closed.
blinding.outputRelease: All eight attempts must be collected and the entire collection closed before production contributors receive source/key/output content. A timeout is preserved; use only the preauthorized same-freeze unattempted continuation after cleanup, with no interim disclosure or tuning. If external failure prevents completion, keep content withheld and report metadata to root for an explicit stop decision.
blinding.authorRestriction: After new facts are seen/authored, the internal eval author does not edit or advise production behavior from them before collection closes.
blinding.independenceDisclosure: Internal evaluation contributor familiar with prior development; separate from production authorship where applicable, not an independent researcher-blind benchmark.

collection.retrieval: Same frozen actual-app evaluation configuration as the known queue, explicitly rerank=false,multiQuery=false,routing=false,wholeDocFallback=true. Do not describe this as all production defaults.
collection.ordering: Eight once-only sequential attempts in the presealed fixed order. No adaptive ordering from outputs.
collection.failurePolicy: On timeout or unsafe state, stop the process and preserve the failure/original denominator. After verified cleanup, root preauthorizes only unattempted-case continuation under the identical frozen candidate/model/corpus/settings; no retry, tuning or interim output disclosure. This future continuation rule does not itself authorize authorship or initial execution.
collection.cleanup: Verify observer drain/disposal and owned-process closure before any continuation; preserve provenance before/after.
collection.performanceRule: Report within180 only for a clean completed terminal and settled invoke with no error, cancellation or terminal mismatch and totalMs<=180000, using the existing pre-chat.stream app capture start. Do not subtract retrieval, model loading or handoff. Native timing and first-visible timing remain separate.
collection.timerMeaning: Prospective300-second end-to-end calibration collection cap; no production answer deadline change. Completion/correctness and within180 performance are separate dimensions.

grading.strictPass: Every explicitly requested part/format and required explanation is present, every visible factual claim is supported by actually supplied sources, local citations cover its inputs/qualifiers, and no unsupported extras are introduced.
grading.partial: A meaningful omission/attribution/format gap is a strict nonpass; separately record any correct requested decisions/values.
grading.operational: Parser rejection/timeout has no inferred semantic verdict. Unobserved is not a fabricated pass/fail.
grading.evidence: Use final displayed answers plus actual fed passage map. Valid IDs, exact quotes, schema acceptance or safe uncertainty alone do not establish completeness/support. Distinguish retrieval omission from generation failure.
grading.manualReview: After full release, production reviewers independently grade before author judgment when feasible; reconcile interpretation transparently without changing the sealed criteria.

privacy: Persist only validated final answers or fixed terminal notices, fixed rejection/structural metrics and safe source IDs/order/provenance. No hidden thought text/token arrays, private check, rejected prose, raw generation envelope, histories, auth/profile content or browser captures.
